name: EXM_VENDOR_EXPENSES
description: The table stores expense data from various vendor integration points.

columns.name: VENDOR_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense from a vendor.

columns.name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.description: Alphanumeric identifier that uniquely identifies an employee within a company.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person identifier of the individual on the corporate card.

columns.name: PREPARER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who created the expense.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of the individual on the corporate card.

columns.name: VENDOR_EXPENSE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense that identifies and groups similar expenses.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Processing status of a record.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the integration source providing expense data.

columns.name: PROVIDER_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the vendor providing expense data.

columns.name: RAW_EXPENSE_DATA
columns.description: Raw incoming JSON payload from vendor integration points.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TIME
columns.description: TImeStamp in UTC. This timestamp would be coming from the vendor for example authorization Timestamp.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the receipt in the receipt currency.

columns.name: TIP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of tip given in the transaction. This helps to manage cases where receipts have different amount because of the tips involved.

columns.name: PERSONAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the expense that is marked as personal.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the merchant where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ADDRESS
columns.description: Address of the merchant present in the incurred expense.

columns.name: MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Identifier of the merchant where the authorization originated.

columns.name: MERCHANT_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CITY_NAME
columns.description: City where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_STATE_PROVINCE_CODE
columns.description: State or province code where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Zip or postal code where the merchant is located.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Rate that represents the amount one currency can be exchanged for another at a specific point in time.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the expense occurred or the first day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: CHECKOUT_DATE
columns.description: Date when a person departs a place associated with an accommodation expense category.

columns.name: CHECKIN_DATE
columns.description: Checkin date at the hotel or the scheduled arrival date in case of a no show.

columns.name: AUTO_PERSONAL_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator of whether an expense is automatically categorized as personal based on the derived expense type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of an expense item, such as cash or corporate card.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Classification of an expense item such as business or personal.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific expense template.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a specific expense type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Grouping of expense types and additional data fields that are relevant for a particular grouping of expenses. An example is airfare. This grouping allows expense types to include information such as class of fare, merchant, ticket number, location from, and location to.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific location.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Location where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Receipt currency of an expense item.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of an expense item.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code assigned to the merchant by the corporte card provider to classify the type of business.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TIME
columns.description: Timestamp in UTC when the notification to the user was sent.

columns.name: FILE_HASH
columns.description: Unique identifier to prevent duplicates by ensuring each file is processed only once.

columns.description: Unique identifier sent by the vendor.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
